name: issta-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for ISSTA submissions: routing testing-and-analysis work into the SIGSOFT venue, HotCRP double-anonymous submission checks, the major-revision review cycle, author response, ACM-badged artifact evaluation, reproducibility, replication packages, review process, writing style, related work, benchmark-driven experiments, and the campaign workflow. Grounded in the official ISSTA 2027 Research Papers call and important-dates page, the ISSTA 2026 artifact-evaluation call, and the PACMSE publication model, re-verified on 2026-11-24.
